Careers at Ironwood Labs

Backend Software Developer, Co-op

Ironwood Labs builds developer tooling for embedded systems teams. We are a fully remote
company with roughly 90 people across Canada.

The Role

We are looking for a Backend Software Developer, Co-op to join our platform team for an
eight month work term starting in September 2027.

What You Will Do

- Design and ship backend services in Rust and TypeScript
- Improve our build and release automation alongside the DevOps group
- Write design documents and participate in architecture review

What You Bring

- Enrolled in a software engineering or computer science program
- Familiarity with at least one systems programming language

Details

Work Term: Fall 2027
Duration: 8 months
Location: Halifax, NS
Work Arrangement: Remote
Salary: $32.00 per hour
Application Deadline: April 15, 2027
